categories.name: Client Invoices
categories.description: Invoices sent to clients for products or services.

categories.name: Vendor Bills & Receipts
categories.description: Incoming bills, invoices, and receipts from vendors for business expenses.

categories.name: Contracts and Agreements
categories.description: Signed contracts, agreements, NDAs, and other legal documents with clients, vendors, or partners.

categories.name: HR and Employee Documents
categories.description: Human Resources documents such as employment contracts, resumes, and performance reviews.

categories.name: Marketing Materials
categories.description: Marketing and promotional materials like brochures, flyers, and ad creatives.

variables.name: client_name
variables.description: The full name of the client.

variables.name: vendor_name
variables.description: The name of the vendor or supplier.

variables.name: counterparty_name
variables.description: The name of the other party in a contract or agreement (e.g., client, vendor, partner).

variables.name: employee_name
variables.description: The full name of the employee.

variables.name: document_type
variables.description: The specific type of the document, such as 'Invoice', 'Contract', 'NDA', 'Resume'.

variables.name: material_type
variables.description: The type of marketing material, like 'Brochure', 'Flyer', or 'Social Media Ad'.

variables.name: campaign_name
variables.description: The name of the marketing campaign this material is associated with.

variables.name: agreement_date
variables.description: The effective date of a contract or agreement, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

variables.name: YYYY
variables.description: The four-digit year from the document's main date.

variables.name: MM
variables.description: The two-digit month from the document's main date (e.g., 01 for January).

variables.name: DD
variables.description: The two-digit day from the document's main date.
